decisions.reason: The MMAK concept has a quantified customer success story and is central to the firm's announced modular direction, so dropping it would write off visible investment and contradict the stated strategy.
The mobile slow-speed shredder is a core offering with its own page in both years, and there is no evidence that would justify writing off the established investment.
The firm presents this product line as its flagship and backs it with a named customer reference and quantified savings, giving it strong public commitment and positive results.
The multi-model shredder line was launched only recently with its own page, and any weak early results can still be attributed to the ramp-up period.
The spiral shaft screen line is new, has several models and its own page, and is still too early in its life for disappointing results to rule out temporary causes.
